article.title: Liability of judgment-debtor discharged.
article.content: No order of restitution or discharge under rule 26 shall prevent the property or person of a judgment-debtor from being retaken in execution of the decree sent for execution.
article.html:
27Liability of judgment-debtor discharged.

Order 21, Rule 27

No order of restitution or discharge under rule 26 shall prevent the property or person of a judgment-debtor from being retaken in execution of the decree sent for execution.
